proposal.description: fault_LED is held in reset while the debounced enable switch is off, as if a switched-off board should show a dark front panel. The LEDs must show what is wrong now, in every state.
proposal.reason: With the enable switch off, a live debounced OTP, UVLO or SCR latch read-back no longer lights Red_LED2, Red_LED3 or Red_LED1. They stay dark until the switch has been on for 20 ms, and the blink timebase restarts on each switch-on.
